Alberta Premier Avoids Separation Talk Amid Referendum Buzz

Alberta Premier Danielle Smith did not discuss separation from Canada during Alberta Day celebrations, despite ongoing discussions about a potential referendum on the matter. A recent poll indicated limited public support for splitting the province. The premier's avoidance of the topic occurred as the province marked its official day.
